summary:
Hi. I write science fiction. You wrote me some letters a couple of years ago that cheered me up at a really dreadful low in my life. I still remember you for that, Sandra Miesel, as well as for the poems and letters.and reviews of yours I’ve seen in such magazines as S.F. Commentdr}. Those letters of yours to me meant a lot, and I’d like to thank you now, inasmuch as finally my life has got­ ten back into happiness. You helped me get through something I otherwise might not have gotten through, and that’s a fact. 

What have you been doing? Here is what I’ve been doing: I went on living there in San Rafael, got engaged—the chick left suddenly and went back to her mother, too far off for me even to visit. I don’t have too clear a recollection after that; I went into the hospital, came out, then found another chick ... in Novem­ ber of last year I came home and found my house had been hit by persons unknown; windows and doors smashed in, everything of value stolen, my fire­ proof files blown open and most of the contents taken, plus all my business papers, letters, everything even from the closets. Rubble everywhere. I still don’t know who did it or why; it wasn’t a robbery as such, more of sort of a combat operation, as my attorney put it. They just wiped me out, financially, profession­ ally and emotionally; for a while the house couldn’t even be lived in, and then after that only partially. I stayed on until February—hardly anybody came to visit me after that, and nobody ever...
